messages:
Sam: Heads-up 10: Large regional bank wants a BYO-HSM POC. Key asks: customer HSM keeps root key, PKCS#11 or CloudHSM integration, signed proof-of-possession at onboarding, 90d rotations, long-term audit retention (7 years). They want timeline and delta pricing vs hosted. Kicking off thread.

Rina: Ok. We support CloudHSM via VPC peering and on-prem via IPSec tunnel + static egress IPs. Do they expect Redwood to ever unwrap keys or only consume wrapped keys? That affects our SOW.

Omar: From Security: prefer zero-knowledge envelope model (we only have wrapped keys). For PoP we need an HSM-signed nonce (PKCS#11 sign) and vendor attestation chain. Need to confirm FIPS 140-2 vs 140-3 requirement.

Chen: Ops note: network needs are straightforward but we need exact vendor endpoints and certs. Also suggest they provide a test VM in their network for an initial handshake test.

Sam: They requested PoP within 24 hours of POC start. Also asked about "no downtime" during rotation. Can our runtime do rolling key swap?

Omar: Yes: create new key version in their HSM, update routing to prefer new version, keep old version for fallback for X days. We'll reduce prefix cache TTL and run canary traffic. We'll include an acceptance test in POC: rotate once and validate continuity.

Rina: Draft config snippet to share with customer: 
```
provider: pkcs11
endpoint: hsm.bank-int.local:9443
auth:
  method: mTLS
  cert: /secrets/bank-client.pem
mode: customer-root-only
rotation_days: 90
attestation: required
```

Chen: Two blockers to unblock: 1) vendor attestation docs + cert chain, 2) IP allowlist for our egress. We'll need those before scheduling network work.

provision-bot: ticket POC-4832 created, owner=@Rina, priority=P2, target 2024-06-14

Sam: Pricing: BYO POC fee (integration + ops) estimate $7k-12k depending on on-prem tunneling. Long-term audit retention (7y) is an add-on; estimate $1.8k/mo. If they want Dedicated capacity that's separate.

Nina (Legal): I'll add PoP and attestation acceptance criteria to the SOW and a clause around key material liability. Also want to see sample attestation format before final sign-off.

Sam: Action items: Rina 12 run feasibility + share sample config by EOD. Omar 12 confirm attestation validation steps and acceptance test by EOD. Chen 12 draft network checklist and IPs once infra gives ranges. Nina 12 draft SOW clause.

Rina: ack :white_check_mark:
Omar: on it :mag:
Chen: will queue infra request
Nina: drafting terms now
Sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
